info.description: Run the requests from top to bottom. Login requests save the token automatically, and 'Get all books' / 'Reserve a book' save bookId and reservationId for the next requests.

request.description: Works only when a book was returned late.
Works only while the status is 'reserved'. After 'Return book' this gives 400, which is correct.
Another way to issue. In the collection run this gives 400 because the book was already issued by pickup code.
Gives 400 'has copies available' if the book is not out of stock. To really test it, set a book's total copies to the number already out (Edit a book), then join.

exec: pm.test("1 added, 1 skipped", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.added).to.eql(1); pm.expect(r.skipped.length).to.eql(1); });
